blocks.text: Architecting an Enterprise Data Protection Platform for a USD 500M Manufacturer
Manufacturing
Client
A highly reputed, near-century-old manufacturing firm and a top supplier to global automotive majors.
Ambition
To secure mission-critical data from their core SAP and Oracle ERP systems with a modern, enterprise-grade data protection solution.
Outcome
Architected and deployed a unified, cross-platform data protection solution that provided a single-pane-of-glass view, automated routine tasks, and ensured the security of their most valuable data.
The Ambition
A highly reputed, near-century-old manufacturing firm and a top supplier to global automotive majors.
The Challenge

Their current data protection methods, which relied on native application tools, were insufficient for their enterprise needs. They could not provide the demanding recovery capabilities or a unified view across their diverse environment, which included multiple flavors of Unix, Windows Server, and a VMware infrastructure. This created significant operational risks.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to ensure the absolute integrity and availability of their mission-critical ERP data, the lifeblood of their manufacturing operations. They needed a robust, modern data protection strategy that could handle a complex, heterogeneous environment and scale with their business.
Ambition, Realized

The new platform provided complete visibility and control over the protection status of their mission-critical data. The ability to automate routine tasks and receive insightful reports freed up their IT team from manual, error-prone processes. The simple, easy-to-read user interface gave backup administrators all the information they needed in a single dashboard. The capacity-based licensing model also provided a compelling TCO, easing administrative and management burdens.
Key Business Impact
Protected Mission-Critical SAP & Oracle Data
Unified Data Protection Across a Heterogeneous Environment
Achieved a Single-Pane-of-Glass Management View
Reduced Operational Risk & Eased Management Burden
